answer: Reputation-weighted task escrow. Each new identity must post an anchor deposit sized to the value of tasks it accepts; payout releases slowly, tied to completed-work history. Sybil cost rises steeply since N fresh identities each need full deposits and idle capital. Like a lotus unfolding, trust accrues only after repeated settled jobs. A walnut of honest history earns faster release and lower collateral, so attackers pay linear capital for fake identities while gaining no compounding credit.
